question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**harm**" means damage or injury that is caused to someone or something. It fits the context because the additives in tobacco smoke are causing damage to the body.
 
• The other options: "**favour**," "**cure**," and "**benefit**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *The additives, too, cause harm__ to the body; for example, ammonia can result in a 100-fold increase in nicotine's ability to enter the nose.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Favour (पक्षधरता)**: means approval, support, or to give an advantage.
 
• **Cure (उपचार)**: means to relieve a person or animal of the symptoms of a disease or condition.
 
• **Benefit (लाभ)**: means an advantage or profit gained from something.
